theorem QOU.KZ.SmallHbar.norm_Φ_sub_one_lt_half {R : Type u_1} [NormedRing R] [NormedAlgebra ℂ R] [CompleteSpace R] [NormOneClass R] (A B : R) (hA : FuchsianFormal.NonResonant A) (hB : FuchsianFormal.NonResonant B) {a : ℝ} (hAa : ‖A‖ ≤ a) (hBa : ‖B‖ ≤ a) (ha : a ≤ 1 / 12) :
‖KZPentagon.Φ A B hA hB - 1‖ < 1 / 2

theorem QOU.KZ.SmallHbar.norm_Φ_sub_one_le {R : Type u_1} [NormedRing R] [NormedAlgebra ℂ R] [CompleteSpace R] [NormOneClass R] (A B : R) (hA : FuchsianFormal.NonResonant A) (hB : FuchsianFormal.NonResonant B) {a : ℝ} (hAa : ‖A‖ ≤ a) (hBa : ‖B‖ ≤ a) (ha : 4 * a < 1) :
‖KZPentagon.Φ A B hA hB - 1‖ ≤ (1 + (Real.exp (Real.log 2 * a) - 1)) * (1 + a / (1 - 4 * a)) * (1 + a / (1 - 3 * a)) * (1 + (Real.exp (Real.log 2 * a) - 1)) - 1

theorem QOU.KZ.SmallHbar.norm_tpow_half_sub_one {R : Type u_1} [NormedRing R] [NormedAlgebra ℂ R] [CompleteSpace R] (X : R) {a : ℝ} (hX : ‖X‖ ≤ a) (s : ℝ) (hs : |s| = Real.log 2) :
‖NormedSpace.exp ℝ (s • X) - 1‖ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log 2 * a) - 1

theorem QOU.KZ.SmallHbar.norm_mul_sub_one_le' {R : Type u_1} [NormedRing R] {x y : R} {d e : ℝ} (hx : ‖x - 1‖ ≤ d) (hy : ‖y - 1‖ ≤ e) :
‖x * y - 1‖ ≤ (1 + d) * (1 + e) - 1

theorem QOU.KZ.SmallHbar.norm_series_half_sub_one {R : Type u_1} [NormedRing R] [NormedAlgebra ℝ R] [CompleteSpace R] [NormOneClass R] (A B : R) (H : ℕ → R) (h0 : H 0 = 1) (hH : FuchsianFormal.IsFormalGauge (FuchsianFormal.kzM0 A B) H) {a : ℝ} (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ a) (hB : ‖B‖ ≤ a) (ha : 3 * a < 1) :
‖FuchsianAnalytic.series H (1 / 2) - 1‖ ≤ a / (1 - 3 * a)

theorem QOU.KZ.SmallHbar.norm_coeff_succ_le {R : Type u_1} [NormedRing R] [NormedAlgebra ℝ R] [NormOneClass R] (A B : R) (H : ℕ → R) (h0 : H 0 = 1) (hH : FuchsianFormal.IsFormalGauge (FuchsianFormal.kzM0 A B) H) {a : ℝ} (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ a) (hB : ‖B‖ ≤ a) (ha : 2 * a < 1) (k : ℕ) :
‖H (k + 1)‖ ≤ a / (1 - 2 * a) * (1 + a / (1 - 2 * a)) ^ k

theorem QOU.KZ.SmallHbar.norm_coeff_le_small {R : Type u_1} [NormedRing R] [NormedAlgebra ℝ R] [NormOneClass R] (A B : R) (H : ℕ → R) (h0 : H 0 = 1) (hH : FuchsianFormal.IsFormalGauge (FuchsianFormal.kzM0 A B) H) {a : ℝ} (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ a) (hB : ‖B‖ ≤ a) (ha : 2 * a < 1) (k : ℕ) :
∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ‖H j‖ ≤ (1 + a / (1 - 2 * a)) ^ k ∧ ‖H (k + 1)‖ ≤ a / (1 - 2 * a) * (1 + a / (1 - 2 * a)) ^ k

theorem QOU.KZ.SmallHbar.coeff_step {R : Type u_1} [NormedRing R] [NormedAlgebra ℝ R] (A B : R) (H : ℕ → R) (h0 : H 0 = 1) (hH : FuchsianFormal.IsFormalGauge (FuchsianFormal.kzM0 A B) H) {a : ℝ} (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ a) (hB : ‖B‖ ≤ a) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
↑k * (1 - 2 * a) * ‖H k‖ ≤ a * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, ‖H j‖

theorem QOU.KZ.SmallHbar.norm_mul_sub_one_le {R : Type u_1} [NormedRing R] (x y : R) :
‖x * y - 1‖ ≤ (1 + ‖x - 1‖) * (1 + ‖y - 1‖) - 1

theorem QOU.KZ.SmallHbar.norm_inverse_sub_one_le {R : Type u_1} [NormedRing R] [CompleteSpace R] (u : R) (h : ‖u - 1‖ < 1) :
IsUnit u ∧ ‖Ring.inverse u - 1‖ ≤ ‖u - 1‖ / (1 - ‖u - 1‖)

theorem QOU.KZ.SmallHbar.norm_exp_sub_one_le {R : Type u_1} [NormedRing R] [NormedAlgebra ℝ R] [CompleteSpace R] (x : R) :
‖NormedSpace.exp ℝ x - 1‖ ≤ Real.exp ‖x‖ - 1
